description: This PHP source file defines a Drupal migration source plugin class 'Language' for extracting language data from a Drupal 6/7 database. It includes methods for defining source fields, querying the database, and preparing each row with additional properties based on configuration.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: A Drupal migration source plugin class for extracting language data from the database, supporting options for fetching all languages and domain negotiation status.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns an array of source field definitions with labels.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Defines the primary key for the source data, which is 'language'.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds and returns a database select query for the 'languages' table.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Prepares each source row, adding 'languages' property if 'fetch_all' is enabled and setting 'domain_negotiation_used' if 'domain_negotiation' is enabled and conditions are met.
